title: Report: Rockstar Releases Three Beer Brands Based on GTA 6 Game Content
description: Rockstar is reportedly launching three new beer brands—Pißwasser, Patriot, and No Mames Vice City—produced by Tripping Animals Brewing, with alcohol strengths ranging from 4.2% to 6% ABV.
youtubeTitle: Rockstar Launches Real Beer Brands Based on GTA 6 - Official Announcement
socialHook: Rockstar is reportedly releasing three new beer brands inspired by its upcoming GTA 6 game.

sections.heading: Regulatory Discovery and Product Launch
paragraphs: According to reports from X, Rockstar is reportedly launching three new beer brands—Pißwasser, Patriot, and No Mames Vice City—produced by Tripping Animals Brewing. These beverages feature alcohol strengths of 4.2% ABV for Pißwasser and Patriot, and 6% ABV for No Mames Vice City, linking in-game references to real-world production.

sections.heading: Uncertainties and Next Steps
paragraphs: While the report from X suggests Rockstar may be creating real products based on in-game alcohol references, several details remain unclear. There is no official confirmation from Rockstar or Take-Two regarding the authenticity of these claims, nor is there a public launch schedule. The TTB database discovery adds regulatory interest, but consumer availability depends on further verification and corporate statements.
